scope: F3 full 5-fold OOF + admission gate. Paired control/treatment: champion's static full view (237 features) vs same + 13 cross-fit residuals. Identical folds, identical LGBM recipe, identical inner ES. Measures true incremental portfolio value.

H51_PAIRED_INTEGRATION.question: Do the 13 cross-fit residual rating features provide incremental portfolio value when added to the champion's EXACT static full view (237 features) under IDENTICAL 5-fold CV, identical LGBM recipe, identical folds, identical inner ES splits?
H51_PAIRED_INTEGRATION.method: Control: champion's static full view (237 features from ViewBuilder 'full'). Treatment: same 237 features + 13 cross-fit residuals (from FEAT51, already computed and saved). Both use identical LGBM xt_xt_f10 recipe, identical 5 primary folds, identical inner 10% ES carved from FIT. Measure paired fold deltas (treatment - control) per fold. Admission gate: mean paired delta >= +1.5e-5, >= 2.5x paired SE, positive in >= 4/5 folds.
H51_PAIRED_INTEGRATION.leakage: Residuals are cross-fit (5-fold, trained on other 4 folds). Static view is label-free. No satisfaction label enters residuals. Fold-safe by construction.
H51_PAIRED_INTEGRATION.decision_rule: Admission if mean paired delta >= +1.5e-5, >= 2.5x paired SE, positive in >= 4/5 folds.

non_goals: No comparison to v7 blend via single LGBM AUC.
